_comment: Working layout for THIS build. Filled live during the Phase-0 CE<->Python loop. Offsets under country_object are STARTING HINTS from the Hexorg table and MUST be re-verified on this build - they will likely differ.

build.exe_path: <read live from the process at attach; install-specific, not hardcoded>
build.note: Reader MUST refuse to run unless the live exe sha256 matches this. module_base is ASLR-randomized per launch - never hardcode it; always read it live and add module-relative offsets.

date.status: Step 2 - VERIFIED (clock found; static anchor still TODO)
date.kind: hours-since-epoch (Clausewitz). value = ((year*365 + day_of_year_index)*24 + hour). 365-day years, no leap. epoch confirmed: 1940.9.2 hour21 = 17000277 (my formula gave 17000278 for hour22, dead-on within 1h).
date.verified_behavior: frozen when paused; +1 per in-game hour when running; two heap mirrors stay in lockstep. Verified live 2026-06-24 on build 16022851.
date.addr: DYNAMIC heap (changes every launch). STILL NEED a static anchor: either crib a module+offset pointer chain, OR 'find what accesses this address' in CE -> RIP-decode the loading instruction (phase0.py aob + rip) to recover the module-relative global. Defer until after Step 3 gives us the first static anchor.

player_country_chain.base: FILL_ME absolute address of the pPlayer global
player_country_chain.note: Resolves to the player's Country object base. Crib the current chain from the FearLess 1.19.1 table in CE.

political_power.note: CONFIRMED tracks player PP exactly (453->304 = 30400000). the game fixed_point = x100000, NOT x1000. This is why every x1000/float/double scan missed.

running_index.note: clean 0..N running index across the whole array - proves it's the per-country array. Player = index 46.

packed_handle.note: 0x2X??AY?? value, varies regularly with index - looks like an internal country handle/generation, NOT an ascii tag. No ascii tag found within +-0x400 of PP, so tags are stored elsewhere (pointer to string, or a parallel Country* array).

identity.deref: u64 at (pp_field - 0x18) -> identity struct S (heap). Validate S is a heap pointer; inactive/dynamic slots hold garbage here.

name.type: msvc_std_string (buf16 @+0, size @+0x10, cap @+0x18; SSO if size<16 else ptr@+0)
name.note: localized display name e.g. 'Turkey','German Reich','Soviet Union'. PERFECT label - no tag decode needed.

identity.struct_plus_0: NOT the tag - it's a 16-byte (ptr,len) field pointing at another struct, not a string.
identity.VERIFIED: 2026-06-24 full-array sweep returned 70 active AMSB countries with correct names/adjectives/PP. index 46 = Turkey (player). Conclusively the country array.

country_record.other_offsets_TODO: civ/mil factories, stability, manpower etc. still to be mapped by dissecting one record vs the UI.
country_record.read_notes: PP read as i32 (signed) /100000. Validate range (some inactive slots / e.g. 'Australia' showed a near-2^32 raw = negative i32 outlier - apply sanity bounds before publishing).
country_record.note: Old Hexorg offsets (pp 0x9C x1000, stability 0x4E8 x10) are for an older build and DO NOT apply here.

country_container.status: Step 4 - SOLVED. all-country iteration works; index->name SOLVED (no tag decode needed)
country_container.kind: id_indexed inline-record array (288-byte records, contiguous, dense index 0..N at record+0x5D)
country_container.record_origin: RECORD START (canonical) = PP field - 0x20. offsets: name_ptr +0x08, PP +0x20, index +0x5D.
country_container.array_base_session_dynamic: rec0 = 0x1F8453A8A40 (record-0 start; PP[0] at +0x20). HEAP, changes every launch.
country_container.record_count: 114 active slots seen (index 0..113); count derived live by walking the index run until it breaks.
country_container.owner_begin_field: M1 = 0x1F843A591D8 (session) holds rec0. Exactly ONE external pointer to rec0 in all memory -> this is the owner / begin field. M1+8 and M1+0x10 are zero (NOT a std::vector triple); custom container, count stored elsewhere.
country_container.index_to_name: SOLVED via identity struct at record+0x08 -> name std::string at +0x10. No country tag needed; localized names are the labels.
country_container.note: Reading name+PP for all ~70 active countries works live by rec0 + i*0x120. This is the all-country iteration the whole plan hinged on.

anchor.status: SOLVED - self-locating, no static pointer chain, no restarts (locate.py)
anchor.why_not_static_chain: Reverse pointer-scan: level-1 found exactly ONE pointer to rec0 (M1, the begin field); levels 2-3 loop inside a self-referential cluster (manager<->array<->sibling); a full module static-data scan found ZERO pointers within 512KB of the cluster. The DB is buried deep in a large game-state object => any static chain is deep AND patch-fragile.
anchor.method: Relocate the array each launch by its structural fingerprint: dense incrementing u16 index column at stride 0x120, validated by dereferencing record+0x08 to >=2 printable country names. Patch-tolerant; ~23s scan; VERIFIED live 2026-06-24 (independently rediscovered rec0=0x1F8453A8A40 and the full 70-country roster).
anchor.liveness: After locate, confirm an EXTERNAL pointer to rec0 exists (the owner M1) => not a stale freed copy. Cache M1 as the same-session fast path: each sample reads [M1] and revalidates index-run + names; re-locate only if it fails.
anchor.implementation: locate.py (locate(), count_records(), find_vector_owner(), read_country()). Seeds on rare mid-range indices (16/24/40/64), verifies the run in-buffer before remote reads, capacity-aware MSVC std::string reader.

codex_review_2026_06_24.string_reader: MSVC std::string SSO is decided by CAPACITY (+0x18), not size: inline only when cap<16, else +0 is a heap ptr. require cap>=size. (FIXED in locate.read_msvc_str.)
codex_review_2026_06_24.fixed_point: x100000 is PROVEN for PP on THIS build only - do NOT assume universally. Manpower may be i64; factories may be state-derived (not country-owned); stability/war-support likely in a politics subobject; fuel may be float/fixed/logistics-subobject. Values > ~21474.836 can't be i32 x100000. Always cast signed before bounds. Save-game scale may differ from memory scale.
codex_review_2026_06_24.read_correctness: date(hours) sentinel (read date, read snapshot, re-read date; accept iff equal) catches hour-boundary races but NOT same-hour mutation. Also: read the whole array in one ReadProcessMemory where possible; re-read any vector begin/end/cap twice; revalidate rec0+count+several indices each sample; if cached begin changes, treat as reallocation+revalidate; NEVER suspend the game in MP (fail/retry).
fail_closed: schema keyed by exe hash (record size/offsets/scale/locator version)
every sample carries validation status/confidence + source build hash
reject if country count out of expected range
reject impossible date movement (regression/huge jump/non-hour step unless loading)
keep golden memory slices for regression tests
Rakaly monthly oracle: cross-check SEVERAL countries not just host
never republish last-known-good as fresh unless marked stale
validate the loaded module not just the file path (Steam can update files under a running process)
codex_review_2026_06_24.next_layers: Map per-country stat offsets by CROSS-COUNTRY CORRELATION vs melted save (70 countries make offsets obvious) rather than slow one-country UI diffing. For record vectors past +0x40, classify as std::vector<T> (begin/end/cap, 24 bytes; valid if begin<=end<=cap and (end-begin)%sizeof(T)==0). Province control likely via state/province arrays with owner/controller index-or-ptr; divisions found structurally by owner country + location province + template/name string + strength/org + stable id.

division_example.loc_addr_or_chain: FILL_ME address/chain to ONE division's current province id
division_example.note: Must track the division's ACTUAL current province (not move-order destination / UI selection). This is the gate on the daily division time-lapse stretch goal.

validators.note: Hard sanity bounds; reads outside these => mark layout broken and stop publishing (RESEARCH section 3).
